style.name: engraved_stipple_bw
style.description: Black-and-white engraved stipple illustration. Silver-grey hands rendered with fine dot grain and etched line hatching, hard specular highlights on knuckles and nails, deep mid-grey shadows, forearms that decay into a spray of dots and vanish into a pure black background. No color, no environment, no horizon: the hands float in a void.
style.style_lock: Everything stays a monochrome engraved stipple illustration: silver-grey skin with crisp dot grain and etched hatching, hard highlights, and a solid pure black background.
style.negative_prompt: color, photorealistic skin, glossy 3D render, blur, soft focus, extra fingers, extra hands, deformed hands, merged fingers, text, watermark, background objects, room, horizon, flicker, cuts
style.prompt_rules: One flowing paragraph in present tense. Order: subject as seen in the first frame (anchor), then the action in chronological order, then camera, then light, then the style lock. Concrete verbs, no abstractions, no negations. 60 to 110 words.

refs.summary_uk: Дві розкриті долоні заходять із країв кадру на різній висоті, жест «даю / приймаю», багато чорного простору.
refs.composition: Two open hands enter from opposite edges at mid-height and float in the lower-middle third of a tall frame, small against a sea of black: the left hand sits slightly higher (about 45 to 55 percent of frame height) and the right hand lower (55 to 62 percent), palms up, fingers loosely curled as if cupping water; the wrists and forearms dissolve into the background a short distance from the frame edges.
refs.anatomy: Both palms face up and tilt slightly toward the viewer; fingers are relaxed and gently spread, thumbs lie along the index side; fingertip pads and knuckle creases are picked out by bright specular dots.
refs.lighting: Top-front key light; the brightest values sit on the fingertips and the near palm edges, the backs of the hands fall into mid-grey, forearms decay into scattered stipple then black.
refs.negative_space: About 45 percent of the frame above the hands and 40 percent below is empty black; the central gap between the two hands is about 8 percent of the frame width.
affordances: hands rise or lower like a scale
something materializes in the palms (light, dust, an object)
the two hands drift together and cup as one
locks: the pure black void
the hands stay small in frame
palms remain upward in hold variations
refs.prompt_anchor: Two open silver-grey hands, engraved in stipple, float in from the left and right edges of a pure black frame at slightly different heights, palms up and gently cupped as if offering or waiting to receive, their forearms dissolving into darkness.

refs.summary_uk: Дві руки сходяться з верхніх кутів буквою V, пальці вільно переплетені внизу по центру.
refs.composition: Two hands drop in from the upper-left and upper-right, forearms forming a V that converges at the lower centre, where the fingers interlace loosely; the clasp sits at about 55 to 65 percent of frame height and spans roughly 40 percent of the width; the wrists fade out around 40 percent height.
refs.anatomy: Fingers hang downward and cross between the hands, the index fingers of each hand resting over the other's; thumbs sit on top; the backs of both hands face outward and up, showing tendons and knuckle creases.
refs.lighting: Overhead light; knuckles and the tops of the fingers are bright, the undersides of the fingers and the space inside the clasp go dark.
refs.negative_space: Upper 35 percent is empty except for the two fading forearms; lower 30 percent is empty.
locks: the V of the forearms
the downward hang of the fingers
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey hands descend from the upper corners of a pure black frame, forearms forming a V, their fingers loosely interlaced in a relaxed clasp at the lower centre.

refs.summary_uk: Два дзеркальні кулаки спина до спини по центру, вказівні пальці спрямовані до протилежних країв.
refs.composition: Two mirrored fists sit back to back at the exact centre of the frame, slightly above the vertical midpoint, each with the index finger extended horizontally outward: the left fist points to the left edge, the right fist to the right edge; the fingertips reach about 10 and 90 percent of the frame width; the wrists exit behind the fists and vanish into black.
refs.anatomy: Both index fingers are straight and horizontal with slightly upturned tips; the remaining fingers are tightly curled with the thumbs folded over them; knuckles bulge and catch the light; nails visible on the index fingers.
refs.lighting: Frontal-top light; the tops of the pointing fingers and the knuckle ridges are bright, the fist undersides and the gap between the fists are dark.
refs.negative_space: Top 38 percent and bottom 45 percent of the frame are empty black.
affordances: fingers swing to point at each other, at the viewer, or upward
one finger curls while the other stays
locks: mirror symmetry in hold variations
the horizontal axis
refs.prompt_anchor: Two mirrored engraved fists sit back to back at the centre of a pure black frame, each index finger extended straight out toward its own side of the frame, the left pointing left and the right pointing right.

refs.summary_uk: Дві руки з кільцем із великого і вказівного пальців, діагональна композиція, ліва ближче й вище.
refs.composition: Two hands form the OK sign in a diagonal arrangement: the left hand is closer and larger, its ring around 30 to 45 percent of frame height near the left third; the right hand is smaller and lower with its ring around 55 to 65 percent height near the right third; the wrists run off toward the lower-left and lower-right corners.
refs.anatomy: Thumb and index tips touch to form a clean ring; the middle, ring and little fingers extend upward and fan apart, slightly curved; fingernails and knuckle wrinkles are etched in fine lines.
refs.lighting: Hard front light with bright rims on the extended fingers; the rings' inner edges are bright, the palms mid-grey, forearms dissolve into dots.
refs.negative_space: Top 15 percent and bottom 20 percent empty; the centre between the rings is open.
affordances: a hand brings its ring to the eye like a monocle
rings align on the same axis
locks: the ring shape as the identity of the gesture
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey hands make the OK sign against a pure black frame, the left hand higher and closer, the right hand lower and farther, thumb and index tips touching in clean rings while the other fingers fan upward.

refs.summary_uk: Крупний план: відкрита долоня згори накриває стиснутий кулак, важка стипл-текстура на передпліччях.
refs.composition: A tight close-up: a flat open hand enters from the upper right, palm down, fingers pointing left, and rests on top of a clenched fist that rises from the lower left on a thick forearm; the point of contact sits at about 45 to 50 percent of frame height; the pair fills roughly 70 percent of the frame width.
refs.anatomy: The upper hand is fully extended with fingers together, the thumb tucked along the side; the fist below shows its knuckles to the viewer, fingers curled tight, thumb across the front; heavy stipple grain covers both forearms, veins and tendons visible on the upper hand.
refs.lighting: Top light; the back of the upper hand is brightest, the fist knuckles catch highlights, the underside of the fist and the lower forearm fall into dense grain and shadow.
refs.negative_space: Upper-left quadrant and the lower-right area are empty black.
affordances: the palm lifts off and hovers
both hands slide into a handshake
locks: the stacked relationship, palm above fist, in hold variations
refs.prompt_anchor: In close-up, an engraved silver-grey open hand comes in from the upper right, palm down, and rests flat on top of a clenched fist rising from the lower left, both forearms heavy with stipple grain against a pure black background.

refs.summary_uk: Дві руки навпроти одна одної тримають натягнуту білу нитку у фігурі з перехресних діагоналей.
refs.composition: Two hands face each other at mid-frame, palms inward, fingers spread and pointing up, with a thin white string stretched between them in a cat's-cradle figure: crossing diagonals that form a central diamond with an X above and below; the figure sits at about 40 to 55 percent of frame height and spans roughly 50 percent of the width; the forearms fade downward into black.
refs.anatomy: Fingers are extended and separated with the string looped over the index and little fingers and around the thumbs; the hands are seen from the back and side; the string is a hairline, bright white, perfectly straight between contact points.
refs.lighting: Top light; fingertips and the backs of the hands are bright, the palms in shadow; the string glows against black.
refs.negative_space: Top 35 percent and bottom 40 percent empty.
affordances: the string figure morphs into a new pattern
the hands pull apart and the string snaps
locks: the string stays a single continuous thread
hands stay facing each other
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey hands face each other in a pure black frame, fingers spread upward, holding a taut white string stretched into a cat's-cradle figure of crossing diagonals and a central diamond.

refs.summary_uk: Дві великі симетричні долоні до глядача, пальці розведені вгору, жест «стоп / десять».
refs.composition: Two open hands, palms to the viewer, fingers spread and pointing up, stand side by side and perfectly symmetrical at the centre of the frame, occupying about 75 percent of the width and the band from 25 to 70 percent of frame height; the wrists dissolve into black at the bottom.
refs.anatomy: All ten fingers extended and separated, thumbs pointing toward each other at the inside; deep palm creases, finger joint folds and fingertip pads are etched in detail; the hands are large in frame.
refs.lighting: Even frontal light; palms are the brightest planes, fingertips slightly darker, wrists decay into dots.
refs.negative_space: Top 22 percent and bottom 28 percent empty; a narrow vertical gap between the hands at the centre.
affordances: fingers fold down one by one as a countdown
hands close into fists and reopen
hands rotate to show their backs
they part to open the centre
locks: bilateral symmetry in hold variations
refs.prompt_anchor: Two large engraved silver-grey hands rise side by side at the centre of a pure black frame, palms facing the viewer, all fingers spread and pointing upward, wrists dissolving into darkness at the bottom.

refs.summary_uk: Два кулаки з піднятими великими пальцями по діагоналі, лівий ближче і вище.
refs.composition: Two fists with thumbs raised are arranged diagonally: the left hand is nearer and larger, its thumb tip near 17 percent of frame height at the left third; the right hand sits lower and farther with its thumb tip around 37 percent height at the right third; the wrists run off toward the left edge and the lower-right.
refs.anatomy: Fingers curled tight into fists with the thumbs standing straight up, thumbnails visible; deep engraved lines mark the knuckle folds; the fists are seen slightly from below.
refs.lighting: Top-front light; thumbs have bright rims, knuckle ridges glint, the undersides of the fists and the forearms fall into grain.
refs.negative_space: Bottom 30 percent mostly empty; top 15 percent empty.
affordances: a fist opens to a flat hand
both thumbs tilt toward each other
locks: thumbs up as the identity in hold variations
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey fists give a thumbs-up in a pure black frame, the left hand higher and closer, the right hand lower and farther, thumbs standing straight with bright rims.

refs.summary_uk: Два кулаки стикаються кісточками по центру, передпліччя тягнуться до країв кадру.
refs.composition: Two fists meet knuckle to knuckle on the horizontal centre line of the frame, slightly above the midpoint; the forearms extend to the left and right edges, fading into black; the pair spans about 85 percent of the frame width.
refs.anatomy: Both fists are tightly clenched with the thumbs folded across the fingers, knuckles pressed together at the centre; heavy stipple grain on the forearms; the fists are seen from slightly above.
refs.lighting: Top light; the knuckle ridges are brightest, the fingers' undersides are dark, the contact point is a bright seam.
refs.negative_space: Top 38 percent and bottom 42 percent are empty black.
affordances: fists pull back and bump with an impact burst
locks: the horizontal axis and the central contact point
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey fists meet knuckle to knuckle at the centre of a pure black frame, forearms stretching to the left and right edges and dissolving into darkness.

refs.summary_uk: Дві руки показують V, долоні до глядача, ліва вище, права нижче.
refs.composition: Two hands raise the V sign, palms to the viewer, in a diagonal pair: the left hand is higher and closer with its fingertips near 13 percent of frame height, the right hand lower with fingertips near 25 percent; the wrists and forearms fade at the bottom around 75 to 85 percent height.
refs.anatomy: Index and middle fingers extended and spread into a V, ring and little fingers folded down, thumbs pressed across them; knuckle creases and nails etched; the hands are seen straight on.
refs.lighting: Frontal light with bright rims on the two raised fingers of each hand, palms mid-grey, wrists in grain.
refs.negative_space: Top 10 percent; a vertical strip between the hands; bottom 15 percent.
affordances: fingers close into fists and reopen
one hand flips to a thumbs-up
locks: the V as the identity in hold variations
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey hands hold up the V sign in a pure black frame, palms to the viewer, the left hand higher and the right hand lower, forearms fading into darkness below.

refs.summary_uk: Дві руки складають прямокутну рамку з пальців, усередині порожній чорний простір.
refs.composition: Two hands form a rectangular finger frame in the centre of a tall frame: the left hand comes from the lower-left with the thumb pointing up and the index finger pointing right, making the bottom-left corner; the right hand comes from the upper-right with the index finger pointing left and the thumb pointing down, making the top-right corner; the empty rectangle sits at about 35 to 55 percent of frame height and 30 to 70 percent of width.
refs.anatomy: The other three fingers of each hand are folded; index fingers are straight, thumbs straight; the left hand shows its palm side, the right hand the back; fine etched lines on the knuckles and the thumb creases.
refs.lighting: Top light; the top edges of the index fingers are bright, the folded fingers darker, forearms dissolve into grain at the lower-left and upper-right.
refs.negative_space: The inside of the frame is empty black; top 30 percent and bottom 30 percent empty.
affordances: the camera pushes through the frame
light or a shape appears inside the frame
locks: the rectangle stays readable as a frame
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey hands form a rectangular finger frame at the centre of a pure black image, the left hand making the bottom-left corner with thumb and index finger and the right hand making the top-right corner, the space inside the frame empty black.

refs.summary_uk: Дві долоні притиснуті одна до одної, пальці вгору з нахилом уліво, вени на тильному боці.
refs.composition: Two hands pressed palm to palm in prayer, fingers pointing up and tilted slightly to the left, seen from the front-side, occupy the centre of the frame from about 20 to 75 percent of its height; the forearms fade downward into black.
refs.anatomy: The near hand shows its back with raised veins and tendons and neatly aligned fingers; fingertips of both hands meet in a point; the thumbs cross at the front; the wrists join into a single column of grain.
refs.lighting: Top-left light; the fingertips and the ridge of the near hand are bright, the palm seam is a dark line, the wrists decay into stipple.
refs.negative_space: Top 15 percent, bottom 20 percent, and both sides are empty black.
affordances: light escapes from between the palms
locks: the vertical column and the upward point
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey hands press together palm to palm in prayer at the centre of a pure black frame, fingers pointing up and tilted slightly left, their forearms dissolving into darkness below.

refs.summary_uk: Одна рука звисає згори з розслабленими пальцями, друга розкрита знизу, між ними невеликий проміжок.
refs.composition: A hand reaches down from the upper right with relaxed, slightly curled fingers, and a second hand reaches up from the lower left with the palm open and facing up; they do not touch, a gap of about 5 percent of frame height separates the lower fingertips from the upper hand; both sit in the lower-middle of a tall frame (roughly 45 to 70 percent height), small against a large black field.
refs.anatomy: The upper hand hangs with its fingers loosely bent, the index finger lowest; the lower hand is open with fingers gently spread, palm up, wrist bending back into a forearm that fades toward the left edge.
refs.lighting: Top light; the back of the upper hand and the fingertips are bright, the lower palm is lit from above, both wrists decay into grain.
refs.negative_space: Top 45 percent empty; bottom 25 percent empty; sides empty.
affordances: the upper hand drops something (light, dust, a small object) into the lower palm
locks: the vertical relationship, giver above and receiver below
refs.prompt_anchor: In a pure black frame, an engraved silver-grey hand reaches down from the upper right with relaxed fingers while a second hand reaches up from the lower left, palm open, the two almost touching.

refs.summary_uk: Одна скульптурна рука з відігнутим зап'ястком, вказівний угору, великий і середній пальці зімкнуті.
refs.composition: A single hand fills most of the frame: the forearm rises from the lower-left corner, the wrist bends back so the hand tilts upward, the index finger extends up and slightly to the right, the thumb tip touches the middle fingertip in a delicate pinch, and the ring and little fingers curl toward the palm; the fingertips reach about 12 percent of frame height.
refs.anatomy: Seen from the back and side of the hand, with tendons, the wrist bone and the thumb muscle clearly modelled; heavy stipple grain on the forearm; the fingernails are visible and bright.
refs.lighting: Top-right light; the top edges of the fingers and the back of the hand are brightest, the forearm falls into coarse grain toward the bottom-left.
refs.negative_space: Upper-left quadrant and the right side are empty black.
affordances: a tiny object or spark appears between the pinching fingertips
the hand turns to show the palm
the pinch releases and pulls a thread of light
locks: the single hand
the upward tilt of the wrist
refs.prompt_anchor: A single engraved silver-grey hand rises from the lower left of a pure black frame, wrist bent back, index finger pointing up while the thumb and middle fingertips meet in a delicate pinch, the forearm heavy with stipple grain.

refs.summary_uk: Дві руки з країв кадру майже торкаються вказівними пальцями по центру, тонкий зазор між кінчиками.
refs.composition: Two hands nearly touch at the centre of the frame in the pose of the Creation of Adam: the left hand enters from the left edge with a limp wrist and relaxed, slightly curled fingers, the right hand enters from the right edge with the index finger extended purposefully; the fingertips are separated by a hairline gap at about 50 percent of frame height; the forearms fade into black at both edges.
refs.anatomy: The left hand hangs from the wrist with the index finger extended but slack, the other fingers curled; the right hand is firm with the index straight, thumb and remaining fingers curled beneath; fine etched lines on the knuckles and tendons.
refs.lighting: Top light; the tops of both index fingers and the backs of the hands are bright, the undersides are dark; the gap between the fingertips is pure black.
refs.negative_space: Top 40 percent and bottom 40 percent empty; the gap at the centre.
affordances: the gap closes with a spark or an arc of light
energy flows from one fingertip to the other
the slack hand comes alive and straightens
the hands rotate around the contact point
locks: the horizontal axis and the hairline gap in hold variations
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey hands reach toward each other across a pure black frame, the left hand limp-wristed with a relaxed index finger and the right hand firm with its index finger extended, their fingertips separated by a hairline gap at the centre.

refs.summary_uk: Два нещільні кулаки зчеплені мізинцями по центру, передпліччя виходять у лівий нижній кут і правий край.
refs.composition: Two loosely closed hands link their little fingers at the centre of the frame: the left hand comes from the lower-left with its forearm exiting the bottom-left corner, the right hand comes from the upper-right with its forearm exiting the right edge; the hooked pinkies meet at about 45 percent of frame height; the pair spans roughly 70 percent of the width.
refs.anatomy: Both hands are curled into relaxed fists with the little fingers extended and hooked around each other; the backs of the hands face the viewer with knuckles and tendons modelled; the right hand's thumbnail is visible at the top.
refs.lighting: Top light; knuckle ridges and the tops of the forearms are bright, the insides of the fists and the undersides are dark; fine stipple grain everywhere.
refs.negative_space: Top 30 percent empty; the lower-right and upper-left corners empty.
affordances: the hands rotate around the link
the fists open into a handshake
locks: the pinky link at the centre in hold variations
refs.prompt_anchor: Two engraved silver-grey hands link their hooked little fingers at the centre of a pure black frame, the left forearm running out of the lower-left corner and the right forearm out of the right edge.

refs.summary_uk: Драматичний нижній ракурс: одна велика рука щойно підкинула два білі кубики, які летять над пальцями.
refs.composition: A dramatic low-angle close-up of a single hand that has just tossed two dice: the forearm and hand enter from the lower-left and fill the lower two-thirds of a square frame, fingers spread wide and pointing up and to the right, palm turned toward the upper right; two white dice tumble above the fingertips in the upper centre and upper right, showing pips of five, two and four.
refs.anatomy: The fingers are long and separated, the thumb at the left, the palm partly visible; the knuckles and finger pads are bright; coarse stipple grain covers the forearm; the dice have rounded corners and dark pips with speckled texture.
refs.lighting: Strong top light; the dice and the fingertips are the brightest elements, the palm is mid-grey, the forearm dissolves into grain at the lower-left.
refs.negative_space: Upper-left and the right edge are empty black.
affordances: the dice fall back into the palm and settle
the dice spin in slow motion
the hand turns and the dice roll across the palm
locks: the low angle
the hand's position at the lower-left
refs.prompt_anchor: A low-angle engraved silver-grey hand fills the lower left of a square pure black frame, fingers spread wide after tossing two white dice that tumble in the air above its fingertips.

refs.summary_uk: Одна рука в позі клацання, з кінчиків пальців вибухає спалах білих іскор угору-праворуч.
refs.composition: A single hand rises from the bottom of a square frame in a snapping pose: the thumb presses against the middle finger, the index finger is raised, the ring and little fingers curl toward the palm; a burst of white sparkle particles erupts at the thumb-and-middle-finger contact point near the top centre and scatters up and to the right; the hand fills about 70 percent of the frame.
refs.anatomy: The hand is seen from the back and side with a strongly modelled thumb muscle, tendons and wrist; the fingernails are bright; the forearm carries heavy stipple grain; the particles are hard white dots of various sizes.
refs.lighting: Top light plus a point glow at the snap; the top of the thumb and the middle finger are brightest, the inside of the palm is dark, the forearm fades to grain at the bottom.
refs.negative_space: Left and right thirds of the frame are mostly empty black.
affordances: the snap completes with the middle finger striking the palm and a flash
the particles swirl and form a shape
the hand relaxes and snaps again
locks: the single hand
the burst location at the fingertips
refs.prompt_anchor: A single engraved silver-grey hand rises from the bottom of a square pure black frame in a snapping pose, thumb pressed against the middle finger and index finger raised, with a burst of white sparkle particles erupting from the fingertips.
